cohort: A total of 91 very preterm neonates born at <32 weeks of gestation age, excluding those with major malformations, genetic disorders, or immunodeficiency, were enrolled from two NICUs in Madrid.
finding: Microbial composition during the first week of life, influenced by clinical factors like antibiotic use and type of feeding, serves as an early predictor of recurrent wheezing and other respiratory outcomes in preterm infants.
mod_finding: Delivery mode was found to be a significant clinical factor influencing the microbial profiles of preterm infants.
